data.indexFullNameCn: 中证消费电子主题指数
data.indexCnDesc: 中证消费电子主题指数选取50只业务涉及元器件生产、整机品牌设计及生产等消费电子相关的上市公司证券作为指数样本，以反映消费电子主题上市公司证券的整体表现。
data.indexEnDesc: CSI Consumer Electronics Thematic Index selects 50 securities of companies involving component production, brand design and whole-machine production related to consumer electronics industry from SSE, SZSE and BSE listed securities as index constituents. The index is to reflect the overall performance of the listed companies within the theme of consumer electronics.
